scope: Defines the minimum canonical job-descriptor field set expected on the sealed intake row for the current mock-enterprise CSV → @enx/job-architecture → @enx/category-engine executable path, and the minimum identifiers needed for auditable equal-value grouping under Methodology v1 framing. Applies to synthetic/mock demonstration data and serves as the reference contract for future intake validators and adapters—not to Wave P pilot evidence or legal sign-off.
purpose: Provide a single machine-readable source of truth for: (1) which job descriptor fields upstream systems must supply for high-yield deterministic category assignment, (2) which fields are mandatory for equal-value grouping evidence units, (3) which absences surface as REVIEW_REQUIRED vs run-level blockers under the current engines, and (4) expected source-of-truth ownership by domain (HRIS, job architecture catalog, reward).

fields.description: Worker-facing or position job title text used to normalize title tokens for category matching and intake sealing.
fields.expected_source_domain: HRIS assignment / position record (primary); job architecture catalog (supporting reference for conflicts)
fields.notes: Mock intake profile treats title as required to seal. Absent/invalid title typically produces job-normalization issues and prevents clean assignment paths.

fields.description: Job family code or normalized family key (after trim/lowercase rules) that becomes familyCodeNormalized for category assignment.
fields.expected_source_domain: Job architecture catalog; HRIS assignment (often copied from catalog)
fields.notes: In mock-enterprise CSV bridge the column is `job_family_code`. Must satisfy job-normalization code-shape rules (e.g. alphanumeric/underscore) where applicable.

fields.description: Second hierarchy axis code that becomes subfamilyCodeNormalized. In the current category-engine implementation, both EXACT and NORMALIZED_EQUIVALENT assignment paths require a non-empty normalized subfamily together with family and grade/level.
fields.expected_source_domain: Job architecture catalog; HRIS assignment (must be carried into intake—catalog file alone is not consumed by the current TS normalization step)
fields.notes: Synthetic unlock finding: when this intake column is blank for all rows while family and grade are present, the dominant outcome is REVIEW_REQUIRED with CAT_ASN_INSUFFICIENT_JOB_DESCRIPTOR and missing normalized subfamily—collapsing assignable yield independent of scenario mix. Supplying governed subfamily (or an explicitly approved alternate axis mapped to subfamilyCodeNormalized) is mandatory for enterprise-usable classification yield on the current executable path.

fields.description: Grade, band, or level token that normalizes to gradeOrLevelNormalized via the job-architecture grade parser.
fields.expected_source_domain: Reward / job architecture (level framework); HRIS assignment (often mirrored from reward)
fields.notes: Unparseable or ambiguous grade tokens can trigger job-normalization issues (REVIEW_REQUIRED) even when the scalar is non-null.

fields.description: Stable identifier for the position or job profile row used to anchor audit traceability for role-level decisions (e.g. methodology scoring unit).
fields.expected_source_domain: HRIS position / job profile identifier; job architecture catalog key (when aligned)
fields.notes: Methodology v1 cites position_id + job_level as part of the scored role unit. The current category-engine assignment path in the mock run does not substitute this for the hierarchy fields above; absence is a governance/traceability gap for equal-value work, not the synthetic unlock blocker.

fields.description: Optional architecture or profile code used for catalog crosswalk, reporting slices, or future reconciliation—distinct from family/subfamily hierarchy codes.
fields.expected_source_domain: Job architecture catalog; reward (internal job code)
fields.notes: Not required for high-yield deterministic assignment in the current rule pack; include when enterprise source systems use it as the join key to governed catalogs.

fields.description: Declared equal-value group identifier or structured declaration consumed when the equal-value assignment path is enabled in engine meta (e.g. equalValueRuleset non-null).
fields.expected_source_domain: Reward / methodology governance (equal-value register); optional HRIS reference fields when explicitly mapped
fields.notes: When equalValueRuleset is active, absence of a declared group can yield CAT_ASN_EQUAL_VALUE_NO_DECLARED_GROUP (REVIEW_REQUIRED). Mock-enterprise baseline/unlock runs used equalValueRuleset null; flags here are false because requirement is conditional on engine configuration, not universal JDMS.

known_failure_modes.summary: Normalized job descriptor incomplete for assignment (commonly missing subfamilyCodeNormalized while family and grade are present).
known_failure_modes.run_impact: Under @enx/metrics-engine, any REVIEW_REQUIRED category rows contribute to classificationIncomplete and can block EU core metrics and reporting completeness (e.g. METRICS_RUN_GATE_BLOCKED).

known_failure_modes.summary: Title, hierarchy code shape, or grade token failed job-normalization rules.
known_failure_modes.run_impact: Same gate behavior as other REVIEW_REQUIRED rows: metrics/reporting may remain blocked until resolved or dispositioned.

known_failure_modes.summary: All normalized descriptor parts empty after normalization.
known_failure_modes.run_impact: Contributes to classification incompleteness and run-level blocking consistent with metrics-engine rules.

known_failure_modes.summary: Equal-value path enabled but no declared group on the row.
known_failure_modes.run_impact: Same as other REVIEW_REQUIRED-driven gate failures when present in cohort.

contract_assumptions: The current executable category assignment logic requires non-empty normalized subfamily together with family and grade/level for both EXACT and NORMALIZED_EQUIVALENT paths in assign-category-row semantics referenced by mock-enterprise documentation.

Job architecture catalog files are not automatically merged by the TS job-normalization step in this repo snapshot; adapters or future intake pipelines must project catalog fields onto the sealed intake row.

Metrics eligibility in the mock run is gated on classification completeness (no REVIEW_REQUIRED/UNASSIGNED for included rows), so fields that cause those states are effectively required for gate-clearing metrics outputs.
Equal-value methodology scoring and approvals are out of scope for this contract file; JDMS only names descriptor identifiers needed to align with Methodology v1 text.
Changing category rules to remove the subfamily requirement would be a product/governance change and would obsolete or revise this contract version—it is not implied by JDMS v1.
synthetic_mode_note: JDMS v1 is authored for mock-enterprise / synthetic demonstration alignment and the observed classification-unlock experiment. It is not real pilot evidence, not a legal methodology sign-off, and not a substitute for Wave P real-evidence readiness artifacts.
